senses.gloss:
जृम्भ mfn. sub. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
 1. Gaping, yawning.
 2. Expansion, stretch-
ing, expanding.
 3. Swelling, a puffing or blowing up.
 4. Blowing,
blossoming.
 E. जृभि to gape, affix भावे घञ्.

जृम्भक m. (-कः)
 1. A subordinate deity.
 2. A yawner.
 E. जृभि, and ण्वुल् aff.

जृम्भण n. (-णं)
 1. Gaping, yawning.
 2. Blowing.
 E. जृभि to yawn, affix
भावे ल्युट्.

जृम्भमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
 1. Yawning, gaping.
 2. Opening, blowing.
 E. जृभि to open, शानच् aff.

जृम्भावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Yawning, gaping.
 E. जृम्भा, and मतुप् aff.

जृम्भिका f. (-का) Gaping, yawning.
 E. जृम्भि and क्वुन् affix, fem. form.

जृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Opened, expanded.
 2. Enlarged.
 3. Done,
exerted.
 4. Opened, (as a flower,) blown.
 n. (-तं)
 1. Gaping, yawn-
ing.
 2. Swelling, expansion.
 3. Bursting, opening.
 4. Wish, active
wish or search for.
 E. जृभि to gape, affix क्त.

जृम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि)
 1. Who or what yawns or gapes.
 2. Expand-
ing, blossoming.
 f. (-नी) A kind of Mimosa, (M. octandra.)
 E. जृम्भ
bursting, budding and णिनि aff.
